articles.title: Volunteers Turn Out for the Spring Cleanup Across Kettle Hill
articles.deck: The money will be spent over the next year, with the first work starting in May.
body: Organizers say the project is on schedule and that volunteers are still needed on Thursday mornings. The group has raised $48,000 so far and is asking for help with supplies and food.
The plan calls for senior exercise class along Sawmill Drive, with work expected to start in May. The Kettle Hill Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library.

body: Public works estimates the work will take about 20 weeks once it begins. Vera Orchard, who has lived in Marsh Landing for 20 years, said the response has been better than anyone expected.
The plan calls for basketball court along Juniper Drive, with work expected to start in April.

articles.deck: Organizers expect about 27 people and say book exchange box is the main draw.
body: The Cedar Hollow Improvement Group will post updates on its bulletin board outside the library. Anyone interested can attend the next planning meeting at the Hickory Ridge rec center on Monday at 7 p.m.

articles.title: Canal Park Elementary Adds Free Tax Clinic to Summer Schedule
articles.deck: The program begins in May and is open to all students in grade 7 and up.
body: Principal Leona Bachman said the program was built with help from parents and local volunteers. The board will review the results at the end of the summer term.
Students will meet on Friday afternoons in the Eastgate community hall, and transportation will be provided for those who need it.

articles.title: Carol Szabo, 94, Carpenter
articles.deck: Friends remember Carol Szabo for the many years of service to Tannery Flats.
body: Carol Szabo died in June at home on Tannery Street, at the age of 94. Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Tannery Flats.
Born in Tannery Flats in the years after the war, Carol Szabo spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Letter: Support the Sidewalk Ramp
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the April meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Harbor Road for 32 years, and I want to say what a difference Scout Troop 14 has made.
Please keep the sidewalk ramp in the budget. Many of us on Harbor Road use it every week.
Jolene Fairbanks, Bellwood

articles.title: Letters: Rowan Drive Parking Is Out of Control
body: To the editor: Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

To the editor: I have lived on Rowan Drive for 36 years, and I want to say what a difference St. Brendan’s Parish has made. Please keep the streetlight upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Rowan Drive use it every week.
I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the March meeting.
Janet Reyes, Stonebridge
